name: UMANG (Unified Mobile App for New-age Governance)
description: Single mobile app aggregating central, state, and utility services (EPFO, income tax, passport, bill pay, etc.).
eligibility: Any citizen with a smartphone; services may need respective IDs.
benefits: One app for many government services; multilingual; Aadhaar/PAN-based auth.
fees: Free app; service charges as applicable.

faq.a: Hundreds across EPFO, tax, passport, education, utilities, and states.

languages_available: Hindi, English and multiple Indian languages
ai_summary: UMANG is a single mobile/portal aggregator for hundreds of central and state government services.
ai_explanation: UMANG consolidates many government services into one app, letting citizens access EPFO, tax, passport, bill payments, and state services with a single login. It is multilingual and free, with per-service authentication.
common_questions: How do I register on UMANG?
common_mistakes: Not updating app for new services
